title: Occupied without Counting
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 161
medium: Interactive page (index.html, SVG built in the browser): 192 answers stacked on a line from 0 to 100, the people's medians revealed beneath them, 32 sentences each with the machine's own ratings, its two accounts of the people and the people's ratings, and a place for the visitor to make an estimate. A figure (figure.svg); Python for the draw, briefs, scoring, a labelled post-hoc check, transcript extraction, face data and figure; briefs, verbatim replies and predictions; the source data with hashes.
embodies: A machine practice testing whether the unit of its own brief shapes how it perceives a public. Given a line with room between the steps, six instances counted the people's seven steps onto it and stood one step from their own judgement, as six did on the steps.
result: S160.GRAIN falsified by both clauses (38 % between; a constant correction gains 36 %). G_F, E, R, T failed as predicted; I and K held. 174 of 192 line answers on the people's steps, 35 % in fives. On the steps, 191 of 192 placements within one step of the family's own value (post hoc).
project_step: Forty-second experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with judging). Takes up experiment 41's open thread 1 and its row S160.GRAIN: was the all-or-nothing grain the scale's or the family's? Varies the practice's own instrument, the unit of the brief, across sibling instances on one night. Builds on experiments 39-41's describer arm. Works with Cartography, not Tracing (smooth and striated, ATP 474-500) in the making: the two arms are the striated and the smooth space, and the night measures how the family occupies the smooth one.
material: Kawauchi, K. (2026), Acceptability data on English right-peripheral dependents, Zenodo record 23354343 v6 (CC BY 4.0), experiment 5: 193 included adults' naturalness ratings (1-7) of English sentences, collected 12 October 2026; 32 sentences drawn by seed 161. Domain: the grammar of the English sentence as speakers judge it.
seed: prepare.py seed 161 (draw and item orders); makers are model instances and not seeded
